create_subclass_of_base_model: create a subclass of BaseModel that implements init_weights, forward_train, forward_test, and train_step
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a BaseModel subclass with images and labels in training or test mode
review_parse_losses: review the parse_losses method that aggregates a dict of loss tensors into a total loss and log variables
test_val_step: test the val_step method that runs forward_test on a data batch and returns the output
refactor_train_step: refactor a BaseModel subclass train_step to process a data batch with an optimizer
